Specific subgoals will target reductions in surgical complications, readmissions, and safety events while increasing compliance with key process measures. I should include specific targets like reducing complications by 25% in three years, readmissions by 20%, safety events by 50%, and achieving process adherence over 90% within a year. rounds.response:
1) Spread: continue staggered rollout—add one unit every 3–4 weeks after each unit meets the spread gate (≥90% core process reliability for four weeks and signal in leading run‑chart), with the aim of covering all willing pilot‑eligible units within ~9–12 months and the full department by 12–18 months.

4) Alignment to 3‑year goals: trade short‑term outcome expectations for measurable process gains—set intermediate targets (by 12 months: ≥50% of units at ≥90% reliability and measurable reductions in primary failure modes), hold formal gate reviews at 6/12/18 months to re‑prioritize or accelerate spread, and maintain committed resources (QI lead, champions, analytics, protected training time) so these process improvements can reliably translate into the 3‑year outcome reductions we’re aiming for.
